components.note: CNN 恐懼與貪婪指數由 7 個因子等權組成：市場動能（S&P 500 相對 125 日均線）、股價強度（創 52 週新高與新低的家數）、股價廣度（上漲股與下跌股的成交量）、選擇權賣權／買權比、市場波動（VIX 相對 50 日均線）、避險需求（股票與債券 20 日報酬差），以及垃圾債需求（垃圾債與投資級債的利差）。台灣的恐懼與貪婪指數依此架構略做調整：部分因子在台灣無法找到直接對應的資料，因此改以相近的台灣市場資料替代，例如以台灣與美國公債殖利率利差取代垃圾債需求，共 8 個面向。各面向的數值為其在歷史區間中的相對位置（0–1）。另附今日在全部歷史資料中的百分位（50＝歷史中位數），顏色與狀態依百分位判斷。

defs: 資金密度：上市與上櫃近 20 個交易日的平均成交金額，除以加權指數每千點，代表指數每一千點背後有多少成交金額。水準長期上升，所以用過去一年的百分位比較高低；它描述市場的資金厚度，不代表市場方向。
外資賣超強度：外資近 5 個交易日的淨買賣超（外資及陸資＋外資自營商）除以同期上市成交金額，與歷史比較得出百分位，再分成五級（Q1 外資大幅買超～Q5 外資大幅賣超）。2015 年以來，處於 Q5 時未來 20 個交易日內加權指數曾跌逾 5% 的比例約 26%（Q1 約 7%），但平均報酬與其他等級相近；它反映波動風險，不代表市場方向。
前 20 大量能：依近 20 個交易日平均成交值選出前 20 名公司（名單逐日更新），取其合計成交值近 5 日平均除以近 60 日平均，與近一年比較得出百分位，再分成五級（Q1 量能明顯萎縮～Q5 量能明顯放大）。2015 年以來，處於 Q1 時未來 20 個交易日內加權指數曾跌逾 5% 的比例約 21%（Q5 約 14%），各等級平均報酬沒有一致的高低順序；它反映波動風險，不代表市場方向。

strategy.note: 本站DCA加值法以 TWGFI 等指標在 0050、正二與現金之間切換。曲線為回測淨值（起點＝100），以隔日開盤價成交、已扣手續費與證交稅；非實際帳戶績效，過去表現不代表未來。共識版為研究中的候選規則：恐懼判斷改由多種指標同時確認；尚未用於本站策略，僅供比較。「無kf濾網」為同一套DCA加值法拿掉 kf 濾網後的對照，用來看濾網本身的增減。

table.note: 定期定額：每月第一個交易日投入 1 萬元（已扣手續費）；各擇時策略另於市場下跌達一定幅度時額外投入，故累積投入較多，期末市值不宜直接相比。策略績效（時間加權）：不受投入金額與時點影響的淨值表現，用來比較策略本身。年化 TWR（時間加權報酬）＝（∏（1＋rₜ））^（365.25÷期間日曆天數）－1，rₜ 為每日報酬（隔日開盤價成交、已扣手續費與證交稅）；期間內無資金進出，故與淨值的年複合成長率相同。

en.CNN 恐懼與貪婪指數由 7 個因子等權組成：市場動能（S&P 500 相對 1: The CNN Fear & Greed Index combines 7 equally weighted factors: market momentum (the S&P 500 versus its 125-day moving average), stock price strength (stocks at 52-week highs versus lows), stock price breadth (volume in advancing versus declining stocks), the put/call options ratio, market volatility (the VIX versus its 50-day moving average), safe-haven demand (20-day stock versus bond returns), and junk bond demand (the spread between junk and investment-grade bonds). The Taiwan Fear & Greed Index follows this framework with slight adjustments: some factors have no direct counterpart in Taiwan, so similar Taiwan market data are used instead — for example, Taiwan and US government bond yield spreads replace junk bond demand — for a total of 8 components. Each component's value is its relative position within its historical range (0–1). Today's percentile within the full history is also shown (50 = historical median); colors and status labels follow the percentile.

en.前 20 大量能：依近 20 個交易日平均成交值選出前 20 名公司（名單逐日更: Top-20 turnover momentum: the 20 companies with the highest 20-day average turnover (list updated daily); their combined 5-day average turnover divided by the 60-day average, ranked against the past year as a percentile and grouped into five levels (Q1 sharply shrinking to Q5 sharply expanding). Since 2015, when in Q1 the TAIEX fell more than 5% at some point within the next 20 trading days about 21% of the time (Q5: about 14%), while average returns showed no consistent ordering across levels. It reflects volatility risk, not market direction.

en.外資賣超強度：外資近 5 個交易日的淨買賣超（外資及陸資＋外資自營商）除以同期上: Foreign net-selling intensity: foreign investors' net buying/selling over the past 5 trading days (foreign & mainland investors plus foreign dealers) divided by TWSE turnover over the same period, ranked against history as a percentile and grouped into five levels (Q1 heavy foreign net buying to Q5 heavy foreign net selling). Since 2015, when in Q5 the TAIEX fell more than 5% at some point within the next 20 trading days about 26% of the time (Q1: about 7%), while average returns were similar across levels. It reflects volatility risk, not market direction.
en.外資賣超強度：第 93 百分位（Q5／外資大幅賣超）；外資近 5 日淨賣超 2,: Foreign net-selling intensity: percentile 93 (Q5 / heavy foreign net selling); foreign investors' 5-day net selling of 2,818 (NT$100M)
en.定期定額：每月第一個交易日投入 1 萬元（已扣手續費）；各擇時策略另於市場下跌達: Monthly investing: NT$10,000 on the first trading day of each month (net of fees); the timing strategies also invest extra when the market falls by a set amount, so they invest more in total and their ending values should not be compared directly. Strategy performance (time-weighted): NAV performance unaffected by the amount and timing of contributions, used to compare the strategies themselves. Annualized TWR (time-weighted return) = (∏(1 + rₜ))^(365.25 ÷ calendar days in the period) − 1, where rₜ is the daily return (filled at the next day's open, net of fees and transaction tax). With no cash flows during the period, it equals the compound annual growth rate of the NAV.
en.已還原除權息與分割，較早的價格會低於當時實際報價。: Adjusted for dividends and splits; earlier prices appear lower than the actual quotes at the time.
en.市場廣度 0.00（參與度極低／多數個股偏弱；歷史第 5 百分位）: Market breadth 0.00 (very narrow participation / most stocks weak; historical percentile 5)
en.市場弱勢 0.73（強勢股動能不足；歷史第 7 百分位）: Market weakness 0.73 (strong stocks lack momentum; historical percentile 7)
en.把各面向依方向拆成兩側，看多空力量各自來自哪裡。: Components are split by direction to show where bullish and bearish forces come from.
en.數值為 v3 分數在自身過去三年（約 756 個交易日）中的百分位，取 5 日平: The value is the percentile of the v3 score within its own past three years (about 756 trading days), averaged over 5 days. v3 follows the CNN convention (low volatility is read as the absence of panic), so its raw score runs persistently high and is shown as a percentile instead. Each component is normalized using only data available at the time, so historical values are not revised as new data arrive.
en.新低多於新高: More new lows than new highs
en.月頻資料，公布後才更新；日線上為沿用前值，非每日變動。: Monthly data, updated only after each release; the daily series carries the latest release forward and does not change daily.
en.本站DCA加值法以 TWGFI 等指標在 0050、正二與現金之間切換。曲線為回: Our DCA Plus strategy switches among 0050, a 2x leveraged 0050 ETF, and cash based on TWGFI and other indicators. Curves show backtested NAV (start = 100), filled at the next day's open and net of brokerage fees and securities transaction tax. This is not actual account performance; past performance does not guarantee future results. The consensus variant is a research candidate: its fear signal requires confirmation from multiple indicators. It is not used by our strategy and is shown for comparison only. "No kf filter" is the same DCA Plus strategy with the kf filter removed, shown to isolate the filter's own effect.
